etymology.historical_story: English pussy brings together several histories. The affectionate cat word relates to puss, while dictionaries discuss uncertain origins for the genital term. The adjective meaning full of pus is a separate formation with a different vowel. These overlapping spellings explain why context and pronunciation matter so much; a single literal translation cannot cover every occurrence. See [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/pussy) and [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/pussy).
